item.title: Internship - ADSC
item.description: During Summer 2019, I embarked on a 16-week internship at Advanced Digital Sciences Center (ADSC) as a Junior Research Assistant. I developed an eclipse plug-in for XSTAMPP which implements the STLSA process. XSTAMPP (eXtensible STAMP Platform) is an open-source platform for safety engineering. STLSA Process is a safety engineering model.

item.title: CDDC2019 - Brainhack
item.description:
Cyber Defender Discovery Camp (CDDC) is a Cyber Security Event organised by the Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA).

About the event

The programme started with a 3 weeks online training on immersive labs followed by an online qualifier for the finals.
